SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_BankTransaction] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction AS (
SELECT TRAN_DATE as 
TransactionTimestamp
, TRAN_ID as TransactionId
,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM as TransactionPartSerialNum
,DEL_FLG as DeletedIndicator
,TRAN_TYPE as TransactionTypeId
,TRAN_SUB_TYPE as TransactionSubTypeId
,PART_TRAN_TYPE as ParticularTranTypeCode
,GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE as LedgerId
,ACID as CoreAccountId
,VALUE_DATE as EffectivityDate
,TRAN_AMT as TransactionAmount
,TRAN_PARTICULAR as TranParticular
,ENTRY_USER_ID as EnteredBy
,PSTD_USER_ID as PostedBy
,VFD_USER_ID as VerifiedBy
,ENTRY_DATE as TransactionEntryTimestamp
,PSTD_DATE as TransactionCompletedTimestamp
,VFD_DATE as TransactionConfirmationTimestamp
,RPT_CODE as ReportCode
,REF_NUM as RefNum
,INSTRMNT_TYPE as InstrumentType
,INSTRMNT_DATE as InstrumentDate
,INSTRMNT_NUM as InstrumentNum
,INSTRMNT_ALPHA as InstrumentAlpha
,TRAN_RMKS as TransactionNote
,PSTD_FLG as PostedIndicator
,PRNT_ADVC_IND as AdvancePrintIndicator
,AMT_RESERVATION_IND as ReservationAmountIndicator
,RESERVATION_AMT as ReservationAmount
,RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND as RestrictModificationIndicator
,CUST_ID as CustomerId
,VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG as VoucherPrintFlag
,MODULE_ID as ModuleID
,BR_CODE as RespondingBranchId
,FX_TRAN_AMT as FxTranAmount
,RATE_CODE as RateCodeId
,RATE as TransactionRate
,CRNCY_CODE as IsoCurrencyCode
,NAVIGATION_FLG as NavigationIndicator
,TRAN_CRNCY_CODE as TranPartCurrencyCode
,REF_CRNCY_CODE as TranCurrencyCode
,REF_AMT as ReferenceAmount 
,SOL_ID as BranchId
,BANK_CODE as RespondingFinancialInstitutionId
,TREA_REF_NUM as TresuryRefNum
,TREA_RATE as TresuryRate
,GST_UPD_FLG as GeneralLedgerUpdateIndicator
,ISO_FLG as ISOIndicator
,EABFAB_UPD_FLG as AccountBalanceUpdateIndicator
,LIFT_LIEN_FLG as LiftLienIndicator
,PROXY_POST_IND as ProxyPostIndicator
,SI_SRL_NUM as SISRLNum
,SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE as SIOrigExecDate
,PR_SRL_NUM as PaymentReceiptSerialNum
,SERIAL_NUM as SerialNum
,DEL_MEMO_PAD as DeleteMemoPad
,UAD_MODULE_ID as UADModuleID
,UAD_MODULE_KEY as UADModuleKey
,REVERSAL_DATE as ReversalDate
,REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE as ReversalValueDate
,PTTM_EVENT_TYPE as EventTypeID
,PROXY_ACID as ProxyAcid
,TOD_ENTITY_TYPE as TODEntityType
,TOD_ENTITY_ID as TODEntityID
,DTH_INIT_SOL_ID as TransactionRelatedCustomerAccount
,REGULARIZATION_AMT as RegularizationAmount
,PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT as PrincipalPortionAmount
,TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID as TradeBranchID
,TRAN_PARTICULAR_2 as TranParticular2
,TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE as TranParticularCode
,TR_STATUS as TransactionProcessingStatusId
,SVS_TRAN_ID as FTProcesingIndicator
,CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG as CurrencyHoldCheckDoneIndicator
,REFERRAL_ID as ReferralID
,PARTY_CODE as RelatedPartyCode
,GL_DATE as GLDate
,BKDT_TRAN_FLG as BackDatedIndicator
,BANK_ID as FinancialInstitutionId
,IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG as ImplicitCashPartIndicator
,PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG as ParentTranExistIndicator
,MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG as MudPoolBalBuildIndicator
,USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM as UsedCleanSingleTranLim
,USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM as UsedSingleTranLim
,USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT as UsedUnClrOverDaccAmt
,USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN as UsedCleanEmerAdvn
,USED_EMER_ADVN as UsedEmerAdvn
,GL_SEGMENT_STRING as GlSegmentString
,COMB_TRAN_ID as CombTranId
,SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE as SysPartTranCode
,USER_PART_TRAN_CODE as UserPartTranCode
,TRAN_FREE_CODE1 as TranFreeCode1
,TRAN_FREE_CODE2 as TranFreeCode2
,RESP_ACCT_REF_NO as RespAcctRefNo
,PURPOSE_CODE as PurposeCode
,'DEP' as SourceSystemCode
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE WHERE isLatest = 1)


SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction FROM Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction_SRC
AS(
SELECT
TransactionTimeStamp, TransactionId, TransactionPartSerialNum, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode 
FROM #Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
, 
Temp_BNKM_BankTransaction_TGT
AS(
SELECT
TransactionTimeStamp, TransactionId, TransactionPartSerialNum, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.BankTransaction WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    ISNULL(SRC.TransactionTimeStamp,TGT.TransactionTimeStamp) AS TransactionTimeStamp
	,ISNULL(SRC.TransactionId,TGT.TransactionId) AS TransactionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum,TGT.TransactionPartSerialNum) AS TransactionPartSerialNum
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId

FROM TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.TransactionId = TGT.TransactionId
AND SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum = TGT.TransactionPartSerialNum
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.TransactionTimestamp IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_DELTA;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.BankTransaction(
TransactionTimestamp
,Transactionid
,TransactionPartSerialNum
,DeletedIndicator
,TransactionTypeId
,TransactionSubTypeId
,ParticularTranTypeCode
,LedgerId
,CoreAccountId
,EffectivityDate
,TransactionAmount
,TranParticular
,EnteredBy
,PostedBy
,VerifiedBy
,TransactionEntryTimestamp
,TransactionCompletedTimestamp
,TransactionConfirmationTimestamp
,ReportCode
,RefNum
,InstrumentType
,InstrumentDate
,InstrumentNum
,InstrumentAlpha
,TransactionNote
,PostedIndicator
,AdvancePrintIndicator
,ReservationAmountIndicator
,ReservationAmount
,RestrictModificationIndicator
,CustomerId
,VoucherPrintFlag
,ModuleID
,RespondingBranchId
,FxTranAmount
,RateCodeId
,TransactionRate
,IsoCurrencyCode
,NavigationIndicator
,TranPartCurrencyCode
,ReferenceAmount
,BranchId
,RespondingFinancialInstitutionId
,TresuryRefNum
,TresuryRate
,GeneralLedgerUpdateIndicator
,ISOIndicator
,AccountBalanceUpdateIndicator
,LiftLienIndicator
,ProxyPostIndicator
,SISRLNum
,SIOrigExecDate
,PaymentReceiptSerialNum
,SerialNum
,DeleteMemoPad
,UADModuleID
,UADModuleKey
,ReversalDate
,ReversalValueDate
,EventTypeID
,ProxyAcid
,TODEntityType
,TODEntityID
,TransactionRelatedCustomerAccount
,RegularizationAmount
,PrincipalPortionAmount
,TradeBranchID
,TranParticular2
,TranParticularCode
,TransactionProcessingStatusId
,FTProcesingIndicator
,CurrencyHoldCheckDoneIndicator
,ReferralID
,RelatedPartyCode
,GLDate
,BackDatedIndicator
,FinancialInstitutionId
,ImplicitCashPartIndicator
,ParentTranExistIndicator
,MudPoolBalBuildIndicator
,UsedCleanSingleTranLim
,UsedSingleTranLim
,UsedUnClrOverDaccAmt
,UsedCleanEmerAdvn
,UsedEmerAdvn
,GlSegmentString
,CombTranId
,SysPartTranCode
,UserPartTranCode
,TranFreeCode1
,TranFreeCode2
,RespAcctRefNo
,PurposeCode
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
) 
SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.TransactionTimestamp
,SRC.Transactionid
,SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum
,DeletedIndicator
,TransactionTypeId
,TransactionSubTypeId
,ParticularTranTypeCode
,LedgerId
,CoreAccountId
,EffectivityDate
,TransactionAmount
,TranParticular
,EnteredBy
,PostedBy
,VerifiedBy
,TransactionEntryTimestamp
,TransactionCompletedTimestamp
,TransactionConfirmationTimestamp
,ReportCode
,RefNum
,InstrumentType
,InstrumentDate
,InstrumentNum
,InstrumentAlpha
,TransactionNote
,PostedIndicator
,AdvancePrintIndicator
,ReservationAmountIndicator
,ReservationAmount
,RestrictModificationIndicator
,CustomerId
,VoucherPrintFlag
,ModuleID
,RespondingBranchId
,FxTranAmount
,RateCodeId
,TransactionRate
,IsoCurrencyCode
,NavigationIndicator
,TranPartCurrencyCode
,ReferenceAmount
,BranchId
,RespondingFinancialInstitutionId
,TresuryRefNum
,TresuryRate
,GeneralLedgerUpdateIndicator
,ISOIndicator
,AccountBalanceUpdateIndicator
,LiftLienIndicator
,ProxyPostIndicator
,SISRLNum
,SIOrigExecDate
,PaymentReceiptSerialNum
,SerialNum
,DeleteMemoPad
,UADModuleID
,UADModuleKey
,ReversalDate
,ReversalValueDate
,EventTypeID
,ProxyAcid
,TODEntityType
,TODEntityID
,TransactionRelatedCustomerAccount
,RegularizationAmount
,PrincipalPortionAmount
,TradeBranchID
,TranParticular2
,TranParticularCode
,TransactionProcessingStatusId
,FTProcesingIndicator
,CurrencyHoldCheckDoneIndicator
,ReferralID
,RelatedPartyCode
,GLDate
,BackDatedIndicator
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,ImplicitCashPartIndicator
,ParentTranExistIndicator
,MudPoolBalBuildIndicator
,UsedCleanSingleTranLim
,UsedSingleTranLim
,UsedUnClrOverDaccAmt
,UsedCleanEmerAdvn
,UsedEmerAdvn
,GlSegmentString
,CombTranId
,SysPartTranCode
,UserPartTranCode
,TranFreeCode1
,TranFreeCode2
,RespAcctRefNo
,PurposeCode
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_DELTA DLT
ON  DLT.TransactionTimeStamp = SRC.TransactionTimeStamp
AND DLT.TransactionId = SRC.TransactionId
AND DLT.TransactionPartSerialNum = SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum
AND DLT.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransaction_DELTA;

END
GO
